definitions.explanation: The twelfth and final month of the year. The year-end season with Christmas celebrations and preparation for New Year.

examples.japanese: {十二月|じゅうにがつ}は{忙|いそが}しいです。
{十二月|じゅうにがつ}{二十五日|にじゅうごにち}はクリスマスです。
{十二月|じゅうにがつ}の{終|お}わりに{大掃除|おおそうじ}をします。
examples.english: We do a big cleaning at the end of December.

examples.japanese: {十二月|じゅうにがつ}は{一年|いちねん}で{一番|いちばん}{忙|いそが}しい{月|つき}です。
examples.english: December is the busiest month of the year.

examples.japanese: {十二月|じゅうにがつ}になると、{町|まち}はクリスマスの{飾|かざ}りでいっぱいになります。
examples.english: When December comes, the town is full of Christmas decorations.

notes: December is literally 'month twelve.' In Japan, Christmas is celebrated but is not a national holiday. The focus shifts to New Year preparations including 大掃除 (osouji, big cleaning), 年賀状 (nengajou, New Year cards), and おせち料理 (osechi ryouri, New Year food).
